scope_notes: Only public commands and SDK outputs were inspected, in an empty owned Rhino document on private Xvfb. Runs occur at idle outside RunPythonScript Undo.

Twenty real reference workflows cover eleven mouse clicks and nine keyboard targets: X/Y/Z axes, Top/Front/Perspective views, two cursor distances, an off-axis cursor, a negative cursor and off-axis first references. Pending cameras and integer viewing rays are captured independently of output geometry.

Each pending observation captures the second-reference prompt and unchanged source geometry before its input. Native EndCommand, post-macro, Undo and Redo states are retained. Application replays compare point geometry and selection within 1e-9; mouse preview maps agree with the final clicked result.

Twelve separate complete macros follow a public line-constrained GetPoint calibration. Their prescribed coordinate target is 6, but output follows the preceding calibrated cursor coordinate. These are retained diagnostics and are not counted as successful application replays.

The original six bare-coordinate macro discrepancies remain in scale_nu.json. Their cursor locations were not captured, so the new controlled evidence cannot reconstruct each original input context. Viboceros does not currently emulate the scripted cursor dependency.

Sources are single points with Copy=No and WorldXY directions. Preview appearance, Copy reference loops, non-world CPlane cursor inputs, mixed geometry under reference picking, option changes, cross-viewport picks, performance and full native parity remain unproven.
